name: Patient Information
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 837.5010.X222.A1.xml — new segment for Phase 2 (loops 2000B/2000C). PAT01-04 (Individual Relationship Code, Patient Location Code, Employment Status Code, Student Status Code) were originally modeled as usage=N at every real occurrence in this IG, on the assumption this IG carries the patient/subscriber relationship on SBR02 instead of PAT01.

CORRECTION (found via testing against X12.org's own official 'Ben Kildare Service' 837P example, September 2026): that assumption was wrong. Real, spec-compliant 837 data leaves 2000B's own SBR02 BLANK whenever a 2000C (dependent) loop exists for that subscriber, and carries the real Individual Relationship Code on PAT01 in 2000C instead -- confirmed directly in the Ben Kildare example (HL*2*1*22*1 -> SBR*P**2222-SJ*******CI [SBR02 blank] -> HL*3*2*23*0 -> PAT*19 [child]). PAT01 re-added (dropped positions 02-04 -- Patient Location/Employment Status/Student Status Code -- remain genuinely unused in every real sample seen so far, kept dropped).
